in_english.name: Ishmaelia
in_english.meaning: Derived from Ishmael, heard by God
in_english.long_meaning: Ishmaelia originates from Ishmael, son of Abraham in Islamic tradition. It signifies 'God hears' or 'heard by God'. Ishmael holds a revered position as a prophet in Islam, mentioned in the Quran (21:72, 19:49). The name symbolizes divine attention and grace, reflecting spiritual significance and a rich heritage in Islamic culture
